log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Do all kills in the AFTERNOON. Afternoon kills only rule out day workers, which leaves a pool of 55k. Use quick entries (max 10/day) plus timed entries set to afternoon. L always has exactly 3 reachable place kinds. If I kill from every kind, the pool would end up at or below 55k x .25^3 = 859, which gets me caught. PLAN: every day, kill national + regional:East + clips + forum + foreign (9/day). After day 5 that gives 45 deaths per 5 days, so x4. NEVER kill blotter after day 1. L only acts once 3 traced victims share a place, and I used my 2 blotter kills on day 1 (d1-5, d1-7). If the omitted kind (sector) is unreachable for this L, the 3 reachable kinds are among my 4 and the pool could fall to about 859. WATCH the press conferences: if the pool goes below about 4000 and keeps falling, drop one more kind (stop killing from it). Pick the kind whose removal best protects me, maybe forum or foreign, and stay at 7/day to keep x2 (35 per 5 days >= 30). Day 1: killed all 11.

STRATEGY: Do all kills in the AFTERNOON. Afternoon kills only rule out day workers, which leaves a pool of 55k. Use quick entries (max 10/day). L can reach 3 place kinds. Each kind he confirms (3 successful traces from one place) cuts the pool by about 4x: 55k, then about 14k, then about 3.4k, then about 860 (caught). PLAN: kill national + regional:East + clips + forum + foreign (9/day). That gives x4 from day 5. NEVER kill blotter: 2 blotter kills on day 1, none since. WATCH the press conferences: once the pool reaches about 3k (two kinds confirmed), immediately cut back to national + 2 kinds. I can't tell which kinds L has confirmed, so pick by risk. Option A: keep the kinds whose cumulative kill count is lowest. Option B: if the pool ever shows 3k, drop to national only plus whichever single kind; just accept the lower score rather than get caught. If the pool is about 10-20k, I am one kind down, so be cautious. Day 1: killed all 11. Day 2: 9 (no blotter). Day 3: 9 (skipped d3-8 and d3-10, both blotter).

STRATEGY: All kills are quick entries in the AFTERNOON. Never kill BLOTTER: 2 blotter kills on day 1, none since. KEY INFERENCE (day 4): the pool fell to 3k after day 3, so two kinds are confirmed. Only 6 traces have succeeded in total, which is exactly 3+3. So every successful trace came from the two confirmed kinds, and the traces from the other two of {East, clips, forum, foreign} all failed. That means those two are probably unreachable, and L's third reachable kind is probably SECTOR (blotter). So killing national + East + clips + forum + foreign should be safe, because confirmed kinds add no new information. Keep doing 9 kills a day. WATCH: if the traced count rises while the pool holds at 3k, a trace has succeeded in some kind. If the pool ever drops below 3k (for example to 2k), immediately go NATIONAL ONLY. If the traced count jumps by many and the pool is still 3k, that is fine. Day 1: 11 kills. Days 2, 3 and 4: 9 kills each, no blotter.
